I would recommend the book to readers who enjoy small mysteries.

How do the reviewer and the brother differ?

They react differently to the quick explanation.

questions.prompt:
When a class in Penang organised a book exchange, Aina volunteered to write the labels. Each pupil could bring one book and choose another. The organisers wanted everyone to find a story they would enjoy, even if they did not know its title.

At first, Aina labelled the baskets “Easy” and “Difficult”. Her friend Vikram hesitated beside a basket. “I like short stories, but I do not like choosing a basket that calls my reading easy,” he said quietly. Aina realised that her labels described readers’ ability more than the stories themselves.

She asked the group to suggest labels about the books. They chose “Animals”, “Adventures” and “Everyday Life”. Aina also added a short note to each book, giving its page count and saying whether it had pictures. These details helped pupils judge the length without ranking their ability.

When the exchange opened, Vikram picked an animal story with many pictures. Aina asked if the new system helped. “Yes,” he said. “Now I can start with what interests me.” She decided to keep the topic labels for the next exchange.

What is each pupil allowed to do at the exchange?
options: Bring two books and choose two
Bring one book and choose another
Borrow a basket for a week
Choose a book without bringing one
questions.explanation: The passage states one book brought and another chosen.
questions.hint: Find the exchange rule near the beginning.

evidence.text: Each pupil could bring one book and choose another.

questions.prompt:
Pasukan Hana menyediakan laluan permainan untuk hari sukan sekolah. Mereka mempunyai seutas tali sepanjang 4.5 meter. Guru meminta dua bahagian dipotong: satu sepanjang 125 sentimeter dan satu lagi sepanjang 1.75 meter. Hana menyedari bahawa panjang mesti ditulis dalam unit yang sama sebelum dijumlahkan. Dia menulis 1 meter = 100 sentimeter pada buku catatan.

Hana menukar panjang tali asal: 4.5 × 100 = 450 sentimeter. Bahagian kedua pula ialah 1.75 × 100 = 175 sentimeter. Jadi, jumlah tali yang diperlukan untuk dua bahagian ialah 125 + 175 = 300 sentimeter. Dia menyemak kedudukan tanda pada pita ukur, kemudian meminta guru memotong tali dengan selamat.

Selepas kedua-dua bahagian diambil, baki tali ialah 450 − 300 = 150 sentimeter. Untuk menukarnya kepada meter, Hana membahagi dengan 100: 150 ÷ 100 = 1.5 meter. Baki itu disimpan dalam bakul supaya tidak menghalang laluan murid.

Rakannya bertanya bahagian mana lebih panjang. Hana membandingkan 175 sentimeter dengan 125 sentimeter, lalu mengira 175 − 125 = 50 sentimeter. Bahagian kedua lebih panjang sebanyak 50 sentimeter. Mereka merekod panjang setiap bahagian dan baki dalam buku supaya bahan boleh digunakan semula untuk permainan seterusnya.

evidence.text: 4.5 × 100 = 450 sentimeter

Siti mahu rak itu mudah dicapai oleh kanak-kanak, manakala Daniel bimbang rak berhampiran pintu akan terkena tempias hujan. Mereka bersetuju mencari tempat yang memenuhi kedua-dua keperluan sebelum membeli perabot.

Buku kanak-kanak diletakkan dalam bakul di atas meja rendah, manakala buku lain disusun berasingan. Sebuah buku catatan merekodkan bilangan buku masuk dan keluar tanpa meminta nama pembaca.

Pada akhir percubaan, sebanyak tiga puluh buku telah diambil dan dua puluh empat ditinggalkan. questions.prompt:
For a neighbourhood reading afternoon in Johor Bahru, Liyana’s class prepared story packs for younger children. Each pack contained a book, a pencil and a card for drawing a favourite scene. The class had enough materials for twenty packs, but nobody knew how many families would attend.

Amir suggested making all twenty packs immediately. Liyana preferred to assemble ten and keep the remaining materials separate. If visitors wanted different books, the pupils could offer a choice instead of opening finished packs. Their teacher asked them to test the idea with three families before deciding.

During the trial, two children wanted to exchange the books in their packs. Another child wanted only a book because she had brought her own drawing materials. The families liked the activity, but their choices showed that identical packs would not suit everyone.

The class set up three baskets: one for books, one for pencils and one for drawing cards. A volunteer explained that children could take the materials they needed. Amir recorded what visitors chose so the class would have evidence for planning another event.

By the end of the afternoon, eighteen books had been chosen, along with twelve pencils and fifteen cards. Liyana did not call the trial proof that every future event should use baskets. She said it showed that flexible choices had worked for this group, on this afternoon.

What is uncertain before the event?
options: Whether the class has any books
questions.explanation: Attendance is unknown even though materials are available.
questions.hint: Look for “nobody knew”.

evidence.text: nobody knew how many families would attend.

If visitors wanted different books, the pupils could offer a choice instead of opening finished packs. Their teacher asked them to test the idea with three families before deciding.

During the trial, two children wanted to exchange the books in their packs. Another child wanted only a book because she had brought her own drawing materials. The families liked the activity, but their choices showed that identical packs would not suit everyone.

The class set up three baskets: one for books, one for pencils and one for drawing cards. A volunteer explained that children could take the materials they needed. Amir recorded what visitors chose so the class would have evidence for planning another event.

By the end of the afternoon, eighteen books had been chosen, along with twelve pencils and fifteen cards. Liyana did not call the trial proof that every future event should use baskets. She said it showed that flexible choices had worked for this group, on this afternoon.

Which material is chosen most often?
questions.explanation: Eighteen books exceed fifteen cards and twelve pencils.
questions.hint: Compare the three totals.

questions.prompt:
Kelab bacaan Sekolah Seri Aman mahu menyemak kemajuan cabaran membaca bulanan. Kelab itu mempunyai 40 ahli. Pada tarikh semakan, 30 ahli sudah menamatkan sebuah buku pilihan masing-masing. Sepuluh ahli lagi masih membaca. Pengerusi kelab, Yasmin, mahu menyatakan kemajuan sebagai peratus supaya ahli mudah melihat bahagian daripada keseluruhan kumpulan.

Guru menerangkan bahawa peratus bermaksud daripada seratus. Untuk mencari peratus ahli yang selesai, Yasmin membahagikan bilangan yang selesai dengan jumlah ahli, kemudian mendarab dengan 100. Pasukan fasilitator menyediakan empat kotak kad yang sama isinya untuk sebuah bengkel. Selain kad dalam kotak, ada enam kad contoh di atas meja. Semua kad berjumlah 38 keping. Tiada kotak kosong dan tiada kad lain disimpan.

Fasilitator menulis 4x + 6 = 38, dengan x sebagai bilangan kad dalam setiap kotak. Seorang rakan mahu membahagi 38 dengan 4 terus. Fasilitator meminta dia mengasingkan enam kad contoh dahulu, kemudian membahagikan baki sama rata kepada empat kotak.

Apakah nilai x dalam catatan fasilitator?

questions.hint: Batalkan +6 dahulu.

On Monday, illustrator Hana spoke to the school magazine. “I am drawing the cover today,” she said. “I will show the first version to the editor tomorrow.” She explained that the cover belonged to a collection of pupils’ adventure stories. On Wednesday, the student reporter prepared a summary of Monday’s interview. The reporter had not contacted Hana again and did not know whether the editor had seen the work. The summary therefore described what Hana had said, rather than claiming that every planned action had happened. The quoted word tomorrow referred to Tuesday.

Using backshift in Wednesday’s summary, how should the first quotation be reported?

Hana said that she draws the cover every Monday.
Hana said that she had never drawn a cover.
Hana said that she was drawing the cover that day.
questions.explanation: Was drawing supplies the requested backshift, she identifies Hana, and that day refers back to Monday.
questions.hint: Keep the action in progress on the interview day.

Ben said that he will finish the cape next month.
Ben said that he had finish the blue cape.

questions.prompt:
The student council proposes a weekly board-game table in the courtyard. Supporters say it would give pupils a shared activity during lunch. A teacher raises a concern: the courtyard is also the route to the canteen, and chairs could block movement. The council responds by proposing two tables in the marked side area, with chairs kept inside that boundary. It also suggests one supervised trial before a regular schedule is agreed. The council has not yet counted how many pupils want to participate. Its proposal therefore addresses the space concern but still needs information about demand.

What is the teacher’s main objection?
options: Board games have no possible educational use.
Chairs may obstruct a route pupils need.
Every courtyard table has already been removed.
questions.explanation: The teacher focuses on movement to the canteen, so the objection concerns access through the space.
questions.hint: Identify the function of the courtyard that the teacher mentions.

options: Bezakan makna literal daripada maksud tersirat dan uji tafsiran terhadap konteks serta kemungkinan penjelasan alternatif.

questions.prompt:
ஓர் அசல் கதையில் நண்பன் பேசாமல் வெளியேறியதைப் பார்த்த கதைசொல்லி அவன் கோபமாக இருப்பதாக நினைக்கிறான்; பின்னர் குடும்ப அவசரச் செய்தியே காரணம் என்று அறிகிறான்.

புதிய தகவல் கிடைத்ததும் கோபம் பற்றிய தொடக்க ஊகம் திருத்தப்பட வேண்டும். வெளியேறிய செயல் நேரில் தெரிந்தாலும் அதன் தனிப்பட்ட காரணம் அப்போது கதைசொல்லிக்குத் தெரியவில்லை.

தன்மைக் கதைசொல்லி தனது அனுபவத்தை நேரடியாகக் கூறினாலும் மற்றவர்களின் உள்ளுணர்வை ஊகத்தின் வழியே அறியலாம். அறிவு வரம்புடைய கதைசொல்லி கூறும் அனைத்தும் பொய் என்று முடிவு செய்ய முடியாது.

நேரில் கண்ட நிகழ்வையும் அதற்குக் கொடுக்கப்பட்ட விளக்கத்தையும் பிரித்து, பின்னர் வரும் தகவலுடன் ஒப்பிட வேண்டும்.

options: தன்மைக் கதைசொல்லி தனது அனுபவத்தை நேரடியாகக் கூறினாலும் மற்றவர்களின் உள்ளுணர்வை ஊகத்தின் வழியே அறியலாம்.

When the flat was finally emptied, Mara left one drawer unopened. The buyer asked whether it was stuck. “It hasn’t opened for weeks,” she said, although I had seen her open it that morning. She handed him every key except the smallest, which she slipped into the pocket of her coat. Outside, she stopped beside the removal van and asked me what the weather would be like tomorrow. I told her it would rain. She nodded as if I had answered a different question. Through the window, the buyer was already measuring the space where our mother’s table had stood.

What does the discrepancy about the drawer most strongly suggest?
options: The narrator proves that the drawer cannot be opened
Mara conceals her reason for keeping part of the flat inaccessible
Mara has forgotten how all the keys function
The buyer already knows the contents of the drawer
questions.hint: Compare Mara’s explanation with the narrator’s observation.
questions.explanation: The narrator saw her open it that morning, directly contradicting her claim that it has remained closed for weeks. Her retained key reinforces concealment, although the precise emotional reason remains unspecified.
questions.topicName: Narrative distance and the meaning of objects

questions.prompt:
Original scene: The mayor stands beneath a banner reading WELCOME HOME. Behind her, workers remove the last bench from the station. “There will always be a place for you here,” she tells the returning commuters. A child asks where his grandfather will sit. The mayor smooths the banner and continues speaking. At the edge of the platform, the grandfather rests his bag on the ground and remains standing. No character explains why the bench is being removed.

What most directly complicates the mayor’s promise?
options: The removal of seating conflicts with her claim that a place is available
The commuters have returned by train
The scene includes more than one generation
questions.hint: Compare the spoken promise with the visible action.
questions.explanation: The promise of a place acquires a second meaning beside the disappearance of a literal place to sit. This contradiction supports irony without requiring an invented motive for the removal.

In an original scene, the audience sees a letter placed in the wrong drawer; a character later praises the supposed reliability of the delivery.

The praise becomes ironic because the audience knows the letter has not reached its intended place while the character remains unaware. The effect depends on unequal access to information, not merely on the statement sounding humorous or containing an opposite word.

Dramatic irony arises when an audience knows something important that a character does not, shaping the interpretation of that character's words or actions. Audience knowledge must be established by the text; a reader's unsupported prediction is not sufficient evidence of dramatic irony.

questions.prompt:
Koperasi Ilham rekaan mahu membeli mesin pembungkus. Penjual A menunjukkan kos pemerolehan RM12000, keuntungan RM1800 dan harga jualan RM13800 yang dibayar melalui 12 ansuran sama. Penjual B hanya mengiklankan “bayaran ringan RM1000 sebulan” tanpa menyatakan tempoh, harga keseluruhan atau butiran mesin. Bendahari mencadangkan B kerana bayaran bulanannya lebih rendah. Ahli lain meminta dokumen lengkap dahulu. Mereka mahu memastikan perbandingan melibatkan aset dan skop urus niaga yang setara, serta menyemak pihak yang memiliki dan menjual aset. Jawatankuasa belum membuat keputusan hukum atau memilih tawaran; maklumat A juga masih perlu dinilai sebagai sebahagian kontrak yang lengkap.

Apakah kelemahan perbandingan bendahari?
options: Bayaran bulanan B tidak menunjukkan jumlah komitmen tanpa tempoh dan terma lengkap
Bayaran bulanan boleh menentukan semua hak pemilikan secara automatik
Bilangan ansuran tidak pernah mempengaruhi jumlah pembayaran
questions.hint: Bezakan aliran bayaran bulanan daripada harga keseluruhan.
questions.explanation: RM1000 sebulan mungkin menghasilkan jumlah lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah bergantung pada tempoh. Tanpa terma lengkap dan aset setara, perbandingan belum sahih.

questions.prompt:
A workshop makes two divisible batches of learning kits, x and y. Every batch uses one hour of finishing time, and only ten hours are available. A separate specialist process limits x to six batches. Contributions are RM5 per batch of x and RM3 per batch of y, with no other constraints apart from non-negativity. The supervisor suggests producing ten batches of x because it has the larger contribution. The planner instead draws the feasible region and evaluates its vertices. She records that contributions are assumed constant, unused time has no alternative value in this model, and fractions of a batch are permitted.

Why is the supervisor’s proposed plan infeasible?
options: It uses fewer than ten finishing hours
It exceeds the specialist limit x ≤ 6
Non-negativity requires x to be zero
questions.hint: Check the specialist constraint separately from total finishing time.
questions.explanation: Ten batches of x satisfy the finishing limit but violate x ≤ 6. A plan must satisfy all constraints, not just the total time restriction.

questions.prompt:
A laboratory sensor uses a flat coil in a uniform, steady magnetic field. In trial A, the coil rotates so that the angle between its normal and the field changes from zero to ninety degrees. In trial B, the coil spins about its own normal while that normal remains parallel to the field. The number of turns, area and field magnitude are unchanged in both trials. A student expects equal induced emf because both coils are visibly rotating. The partner instead calculates flux from orientation. The coil terminals are connected only to an ideal voltmeter, so the experiment compares emf without assuming an appreciable current through a closed load.

Which trial has a net change in flux from beginning to end?
options: Both trials have identical flux changes
Neither trial can change flux in a steady field
questions.hint: The field can remain steady while the orientation of the area changes.
questions.explanation: In A, flux changes from BA to zero per turn. In B, the normal remains parallel to the field, so BA cos θ stays constant despite visible rotation.

questions.prompt:
A 120-turn coil has area 0.015 m² per turn and total resistance 6.0 Ω in a closed circuit. Its normal is parallel to a uniform field directed into the page. The field increases linearly from 0.20 T to 0.50 T in 0.10 s. Ignore self-inductance and all other emf sources. View the coil directly face-on. After the change, the field is held constant at 0.50 T.

What is the change in flux linkage during the increase?
questions.hint: Multiply the flux change per turn by 120.
questions.explanation: Δ(NΦ) = 120 × 0.015 × (0.50 − 0.20) = 0.54 Wb-turn. The value 0.0045 Wb is the flux change for one turn only.

questions.prompt:
Two sealed vessels contain identical initial mixtures for the model reaction A(g) + B(g) ⇌ C(g). Both vessels are kept at the same constant temperature and volume. A suitable catalyst is added to one vessel. Measurements show that its concentrations become steady after four minutes, while the uncatalysed vessel requires twenty minutes. At the end, both vessels have [A] = 0.50 mol dm⁻³, [B] = 0.50 mol dm⁻³ and [C] = 1.00 mol dm⁻³. A student says the catalyst has made the reaction more product-favoured. The teacher asks the student to distinguish the time taken from the final concentration ratio before interpreting the results.

What value of Kc is obtained from either final mixture?
questions.hint: Use [C]/([A][B]) for the reaction as written.
questions.explanation: Kc = 1.00/(0.50 × 0.50) = 4.00 dm³ mol⁻¹ in the stated concentration convention. Both final mixtures give the same value.

questions.prompt:
A teaching laboratory measures initial rates of the same enzyme with and without substance X. Temperature, pH and enzyme concentration are held constant. At low substrate concentrations, rates with X are smaller. As substrate concentration becomes very high, both curves approach 100 arbitrary rate units. The substrate concentration giving a rate of 50 units is 2 mmol dm⁻³ without X and 6 mmol dm⁻³ with X. The students propose an ideal competitive inhibition model. Their supervisor accepts it as a useful explanation of the pattern but asks for additional experiments before claiming the exact binding interaction of X has been directly observed.

What parameter pattern is supported by the observations?
options: Lower Vmax with unchanged apparent Km
Both Vmax and apparent Km become zero
Unchanged Vmax with a larger apparent Km in the presence of X
Vmax triples while apparent Km is unchanged
questions.hint: Identify the common plateau and the concentration at half that plateau.
questions.explanation: Both curves approach 100, so Vmax is unchanged in the fitted model. Half-maximal rate requires 6 rather than 2 mmol dm⁻³ substrate with X, indicating a larger apparent Km.

questions.prompt:
Dalam demonstrasi biomekanik menggunakan model lengan, daya beban yang sama diletakkan pada dua kedudukan. Pada kedudukan A, jarak serenjang dari paksi siku ialah 0.25 m; pada B, jaraknya 0.15 m. Berat segmen dan lengan momen daya otot dikekalkan dalam model. Seorang pelajar menjangka daya otot sama kerana beban luar tidak berubah. Pelajar lain membezakan magnitud daya daripada kesan putarannya. Pensyarah meminta mereka mengira momen beban dahulu dan menyatakan andaian sebelum membincangkan daya otot. Demonstrasi ini ialah analisis model statik, bukan arahan memilih beban senaman atau kaedah merawat kecederaan.

Bagaimanakah momen beban pada B dibandingkan dengan A?
options: Momen B ialah 60% daripada momen A
Momen B ialah 40% daripada momen A
Momen B ialah 150% daripada momen A
questions.hint: Daya sama, jadi nisbah momen sama dengan nisbah jarak serenjang.
questions.explanation: τB/τA = 0.15/0.25 = 0.60. Magnitud beban sahaja tidak menentukan momen; kedudukan garis tindakannya turut penting.

evidence.text: Mulakan dengan pemerihalan, analisis hubungan dan tafsiran, kemudian berikan penilaian bersama bukti visual yang khusus.
